channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Troy Weaver | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Troy Weaver from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tom Gores on Troy Weaver
item.description:
Gores:

“I do appreciate Troy Weaver. He had the courage to restructure and we have cap room. I want to think Monty and his family for coming to Detroit and taking a chance on us.”

Tom Gores on Troy Weaver, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: DJ Bakker on Troy Weaver, Arn Tellem, Tom Gores
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dj Bakker on the opportunity to coach the Cruise:

“Very thankful to our ownership group of Tom Gores, Arn Tellem; and Troy Weaver and Rob (Murphy).”

DJ Bakker on Troy Weaver, Arn Tellem, Tom Gores, Aug 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Ben Wallace on Troy Weaver
item.description:
#PistonsBen Wallace on Troy Weaver:

“Troy has done a hell of a job for this to be his first year. The team is in a much better place right nowand we're heading in the right direction.”

Ben Wallace on Troy Weaver, Jun 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Troy Weaver, Tyler Cook
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Tyler Cook:

“He's earned a second 10-day contract,and I'm glad Troy (Weaver) gave him a second one.”

Dwane Casey on Troy Weaver, Tyler Cook, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Troy Weaver
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Troy Weaver's approach early on:

“We're not a finished product, but so far so good. Troy has done a good job of evaluating needs and the league.”

Dwane Casey on Troy Weaver, Jan 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Tom Gores on Troy Weaver
item.description:
#Pistons Tom Gores on Troy Weaver's changes:

“He was thoughtfully aggressive and he owned it, with three first-round draft picks. That's pretty aggressive... I like it, and we still have Sekou and Svi. We needed to move in a different direction; we weren't making enough progress.”

Tom Gores on Troy Weaver, Dec 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Tom Gores on Troy Weaver
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Tom Gores:

“Troy (Weaver), like me, doesn't want to go out here with this tanking thing.”

Tom Gores on Troy Weaver, Dec 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Troy Weaver
item.description:
James Edwards III:Grant on Weaver's impact on him coming to Detroit:

“There's definitely a trust thing there. It played a big part on my decision.”

Jerami Grant on Troy Weaver, Dec 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Josh Jackson on Dwane Casey, Troy Weaver
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Josh Jackson on coming to Detroit with Troy Weaver and Dwane Casey:

“It just felt right... It was really easy for me to make that decision.”

Josh Jackson on Dwane Casey, Troy Weaver, Dec 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Chris Paul on Troy Weaver
item.description:
Rod Beard:Chris Paul on Troy Weaver as #Pistons GM:

“Troy is amazing. When I saw he was up for the job, I told my brother, ‘He’s going to get it.’”

Chris Paul on Troy Weaver, Jun 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Sam Presti on Troy Weaver
item.description:
#Thunder GM Sam Presti on Troy Weaver:

“Troy has been an integral member of our organization since 2008. Aside from being a terrific basketball executive, Troy's personal values of honesty, unity, and hard work make him a great addition to the Pistons organization.”

Sam Presti on Troy Weaver, Jun 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Tom Gores on Troy Weaver
item.description:
Eric Woodyard:Pistons Owner Tom Gores on hiring new GM Troy Weaver:

“We just felt it was time to go big or go home.”

Tom Gores on Troy Weaver, Jun 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @E_Woodyard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Troy Weaver
item.description:
#Pistons coachDwane Casey on new GM Troy Weaver:

“We're rebuilding our roster and Troy brings a tremendous amount of experience. He's one of those guys who has a knack for talent... the next couple of years of developing our roster is a key team in our organization.”

Dwane Casey on Troy Weaver, Jun 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Tom Gores on Troy Weaver
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons team owner Tom Gores on new GM Troy Weaver:

“Troy is an outstanding executive with an exceptional track record for identifying and developing talent.”

Tom Gores on Troy Weaver, Jun 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Nick Collison, Sam Presti, Troy Weaver, Russell Westbrook, Clay Bennett
item.description:
“No matter if they talk to me or they're mad at me. Whether it's Sam Presti or Troy Weaver or Russell Westbrook or Nick Collison. Whether it's Wilson Taylor or Clay Bennett and his family, I love them from the bottom of my heart. We're not talking, but eventually we will.”

Kevin Durant on Nick Collison, Sam Presti, Troy Weaver, Russell Westbrook, Clay Bennett, Nov 16, 2017. Source: Bleacher Report.
